description: This file defines the JobsFragment class, a UI component for displaying a list of jobs within an Android application. It initializes a RecyclerView, loads job data from internal storage, parses JSON data, and populates the list with Job objects.

classes.name: JobsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass responsible for displaying a list of jobs in a RecyclerView, loading data from internal storage, parsing JSON, and updating the UI.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes RecyclerView, and sets up the layout manager and item decoration.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Reads JSON data from internal storage, parses it into Job objects, and updates the RecyclerView adapter.
